description: This header file defines template classes for 3D and 2D tables used in engine control software, including methods for initialization, value retrieval, and table manipulation. It also declares external functions and type definitions related to engine parameter mapping.

classes.name: Map3D
classes.description: Template class representing a 3D map with methods for initialization, value retrieval, and setting all values.

classes.name: Table2D
classes.description: Template class representing a 2D table with pre-calculation of interpolation coefficients.

methods.name: Map3D::Map3D
methods.description: Constructs a Map3D object with a name and optional multiplier.

methods.name: Map3D::init
methods.description: Initializes the 3D map with table data and axis bins.

methods.name: Map3D::getValue
methods.description: Retrieves interpolated value from the 3D map based on RPM and load.

methods.name: Map3D::setAll
methods.description: Sets all points in the map to a specified value.

methods.name: Table2D::preCalc
methods.description: Pre-calculates interpolation coefficients based on bin points and values.
